wrong_turns: A rider leaving one deck early may disengage the WAIT FOR BOTH clutch; the exact dependency is untested.
One nutrient sac may need to remain on each side, per Cana's line, so sharing or parking both together might fail.
The upper-right ISP DELIVERY and lower-left CARGO PARKED x2 labels imply an exchange, but direction and cargo transport controls are unknown.
The two sparks are tracked separately and are not assumed mandatory.
unknowns: No player key action, cargo transport, clutch trigger, door opening, fall, or reset is observed.
The deck labels change during idle time; those visible state differences do not prove player-caused behavior.
Earlier cue exposure is not proof of player practice or mastery.
Extra one-operator demands are outside two-human ratings.
